zh.title: 立榮華信申請停飛花蓮三航線民航局審查中
zh.summary: 立榮華信申請停飛花蓮三條航線，民航局已收件並正在審查中
body: 立榮航空與華信航空相繼向民航局申請停飛台北-花蓮、高雄-花蓮及台中-花蓮三條航線。
民航局證實已收到立榮申請並正在審查，同時要求華信補充資料。
根據民航局統計，立榮台北-花蓮載客率僅24.2%，華信台中-花蓮57.5%、高雄-花蓮42%，均低於離島航線。
立榮表示北部旅客多靠陸路，申請停航以將運能轉往離島航線。
民航局指出將依法審查並考量偏遠地區交通需求，後續將公告審查結果。
此舉反映國內支線航線載客率長期偏低，航空公司正評估資源配置。

en.title: Mandarin, UNI apply to suspend three Hualien routes; CAA reviewing
en.summary: Mandarin and UNI seek to suspend three Hualien routes; CAA reviewing applications
body: Mandarin Airlines and UNI Air have each applied to the Civil Aeronautics Administration to suspend three Hualien routes: Taipei‑Hualien, Kaohsiung‑Hualien and Taichung‑Hualien.
The CAA confirmed receipt of Mandarin’s application and is reviewing it, while it has asked UNI Air to provide supplementary information for its two applications.
CAA statistics show Mandarin’s Taipei‑Hualien load factor at 24.2% for Jan‑Jun, UNI’s Taichung‑Hualien at 57.5% and Kaohsiung‑Hualien at 42%, all well below island routes.
Mandarin said northern passengers rely on ground transport, so it seeks to shift capacity to higher‑demand island routes in June.

sources.name: 中央社 CNA 國籍航空 — 華信立榮相繼申請停飛花蓮 民航局審查中

facts.claim: Mandarin Airlines applied to suspend the Taipei‑Hualien route and the CAA confirmed receipt and is reviewing.
facts.sourceQuote: 立榮航空日前向民航局提出申請停飛台北-花蓮航線，民航局今天證實已收到申請，都在審查中。

facts.claim: Mandarin Airlines' Taipei‑Hualien load factor for January‑June 2026 was 24.2%.
facts.sourceQuote: 根據交通部民用航空局統計，今年1至6月立榮航空的台北-花蓮航線載客率為24.2%，是目前唯一執飛這條航線的航空公司。

facts.claim: UNI Air's Taichung‑Hualien load factor was 57.5% and Kaohsiung‑Hualien 42% for January‑June 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: 另外，華信航空台中-花蓮1至6月的載客率為57.5%；高雄-花蓮1至6月的載客率為42%。

facts.claim: Mandarin Airlines stated northern passengers rely on land transport, leading to low demand for Taipei‑Hualien, and applied at end of June to suspend the route to reallocate capacity to island routes.
facts.sourceQuote: 立榮航空指出，北部旅客往返花蓮高度仰賴陸路，對台北-花蓮航線空運需求低，離島航線則運能需求大，為使有限的航空資源能有較佳運用，於6月底向民航局申請台北-花蓮航線停航，希望能將運能轉至離島航線。

facts.claim: The CAA said it has received Mandarin's application to suspend Taipei‑Hualien and is reviewing it.
facts.sourceQuote: 民航局今天向媒體表示，已收到立榮航空申請停飛台北-花蓮航線資料，目前審查中。

facts.claim: The CAA asked UNI Air to provide supplementary information for its applications to suspend Kaohsiung‑Hualien and Taichung‑Hualien.
facts.sourceQuote: 另外，針對華信航空申請停飛高雄-花蓮、台中-花蓮航線部分，民航局初步檢視資料後，已要求業者提供補充資料。

zh.title: 日本樂天攜手德國Helsing推動攻擊型無人機引進日本
zh.summary: 樂天與Helsing合作；向陸上自衛隊提案攻擊型無人機；考慮日本國產化
body: 日本樂天集團將與德國國防新創企業Helsing展開合作，向陸上自衛隊提案採用Helsing的攻擊型無人機，協助將相關產品引進日本，並考慮在日本國內實現無人機國產化。
Helsing開發搭載人工智慧、具備攻擊能力的自律型無人機，並已供應給烏克蘭，未來也預計供貨給德國聯邦國防軍。由於Helsing目前在日本尚無實績，樂天將作為雙方合作窗口，協助引進相關產品。
接下來預計除了在陸上自衛隊進行Helsing無人機的實證測試外，也將共享最新產品資訊，以促成後續採購。若要在日本國內量產無人機，雙方也將進行合作。
日本政府預計於2026年內修訂安全保障相關三文件，屆時將提出強化國內無人機量產基礎的方針。

en.title: Rakuten partners with Germany's Helsing to bring attack drones to Japan
en.summary: Rakuten and Helsing to cooperate; propose attack drones to JGSDF; consider domestic production
body: Japan's Rakuten Group will partner with German defense startup Helsing to propose Helsing's attack drones to the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force (JGSDF), help introduce the products to Japan, and consider domestic drone production.

Helsing develops AI-equipped autonomous attack drones and has supplied them to Ukraine, with future deliveries planned for the German Bundeswehr. As Helsing has no track record in Japan, Rakuten will serve as the cooperation window to help introduce the products.

Plans include conducting demonstration tests of Helsing drones with the JGSDF and sharing latest product information to facilitate future procurement. The two companies will also cooperate if domestic mass production of drones in Japan is pursued.
The Japanese government plans to revise its three security-related documents within 2026, when it will present a policy to strengthen domestic drone production infrastructure.
